name: Tm Visualization Suite: Relationship Explorer
pitch: See how suppliers, sites and customers connect, and which links carry the most volume.
question: Who is connected to whom, and how strong are the links?
useWhen: Show links and flows between two sets of things.
features: Follow the flow from one stage to the next
Find the hubs in a network
Read many links along one line
Look up any pair in a matrix

hero.alt: Chord diagram of suppliers and distribution centers, with ribbons whose width shows the volume between them.
hero.caption: Who supplies whom: ribbon width shows the volume

screenshots.alt: Chord diagram of suppliers and distribution centers for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2025.
screenshots.caption: Select a quarter and the chord shows only that period

screenshots.alt: Network diagram of suppliers and sites for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2025.
screenshots.caption: The same network for one quarter shows which hubs change

questions: Which suppliers deliver to which distribution centers?
Which connections carry the most volume?
How does the flow change from one quarter to the next?
audience: Analysts and BI leads who study flows and links between suppliers, sites, teams or customers.

featureStrips.heading: Follow the flow from one stage to the next
featureStrips.text: An alluvial diagram sends each supplier's volume to the sites that receive it, so shifts between stages show.
featureStrips.alt: Alluvial diagram with suppliers on the left and receiving sites on the right, joined by bands of different widths.

featureStrips.heading: Find the hubs in a network
featureStrips.text: A network draws each party as a node and each link as a line, so busy hubs and lone nodes stand out.
featureStrips.alt: Network diagram of suppliers and sites, with a few hub nodes joined to many others.

featureStrips.heading: Read many links along one line
featureStrips.text: An arc diagram puts every party on one line and draws each link as an arc, so long and short links compare.
featureStrips.alt: Arc diagram with suppliers and sites in a row and arcs above the line for each link.

featureStrips.heading: Look up any pair in a matrix
featureStrips.text: An adjacency matrix gives every pair its own cell, so dense and empty areas show without any overlap.
featureStrips.alt: Matrix with suppliers as rows and sites as columns, cells shaded by the volume between each pair.
